children: BlockBeats reported on September 27 that two addresses were holding combined unrealized losses of about $25.89 million on NEAR short positions as of 14:23 on September 27. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, one address beginning with 0xfe7c held about 4.32 million NEAR short positions at an average entry price of $2.55352, with an unrealized loss of about $12.44 million.

Since the afternoon of September 26, the address has reduced its NEAR short position by about 771,700 tokens, realizing a loss of about $1.77 million on those closed positions. Another address beginning with 0xdd53 held about 4.31 million NEAR short positions at an average entry price of $2.31039, with an unrealized loss of about $13.45 million.

Since September 24, that address has reduced its NEAR short position by only about 5,293 tokens and still retains most of its position. It also closed part of its ZEC short position today, resulting in a realized loss of about $238,100, while the remaining ZEC short position is currently showing an unrealized loss of about $9.23 million.

title: Two NEAR Short Positions Hold Combined Unrealized Losses of About $25.89 Million
